Definition
[Attaching one space to another]

\group CW Complexes

Given $A\subset X_1$, $X_0\sqcup _fX_1$ denotes the quotient of $X_0\sqcup X_1$ by $a\sim f(a)$ for a map $f:A\to X_0$. For $(X_1,A)=(D^n,S^{n-1})$ this is attachment of an $n$-cell.

The mapping cylinder is obtained by attaching $X\times I$ to $Y$ along $X\times \{ 1\} $, and the mapping cone is the analogous construction with the cone.
